commit:
doc: render the `Database#busy_timeout=` description (#787)

The generated docs showed `Database#busy_timeout=` with no call-seq and
no description. RDoc read the call-seq `db.busy_timeout = ms` as a call
of the alias `busy_timeout`, dropped it from the setter, and then
skipped the setter's description.

Write the call-seq as `db.busy_timeout=(ms)`.

Defining the alias in C, as proposed in #772, does not help: RDoc applies
the same call-seq rule to an alias defined in C.

[Fix #772]
